{{Quote|There is darkness everywhere on Tython. But the dangers of the Gnarls&hellip;|Matare, speaking of the planet Tython|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Matare''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the Republic. He was one of many Jedi who relocated to the Jedi [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] after the Order relocated there to rebuild at the conclusion of the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. While on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Matare frequented the [[Masters' Retreat]], an [[Jedi Enclaves|enclave]] near the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Tython. Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], the [[Flesh Raider]]s, a savage [[Species/Legends|species]] native to Tython, began to [[Flesh Raider uprising|attack]] Jedi and others in the [[Tythonian Gnarls|Gnarls]] and other regions around the Jedi Temple, which led Matare to believe that the Jedi should no longer send their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] to the Gnarls for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I am afraid the Gnarls are not longer an ideal place for Padawans.|Matare, speaking of the Gnarls|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], Matare was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-using]] individuals who acted as peacekeepers for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Following the [[Great Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Jedi returned to their ancestral [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] and worked to rebuild their Order after their losses during the war. During this [[Time/Legends|time]] of rebuilding, which occurred during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Sith Empire and Galactic Republic, Matare was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and stayed at the [[Masters' Retreat]], a [[Jedi Enclaves|Jedi Enclave]] located near the world's [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TORdate">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> a native [[Species/Legends|species]] of violent savages known as the [[Flesh Raider]]s began to [[Flesh Raider uprising|attack]] Jedi and other individuals in the regions around the Jedi Temple. Matare believed that the region of Tython known as the [[Tythonian Gnarls|Gnarls]] had become too dangerous for Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] to train in. During the Flesh Raider attacks, Matare discussed the situation in the Gnarls with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Benn]], who believed that it was important for the Padawans to learn to identify darkness and dangerous situations during the dark times in which the Order was locked. While Matare agreed with Benn to some extent, he still believed that the Order could only survive so many losses.<ref name="TOR" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|As you say, Master. But we can only afford to lose so many.|Matare, speaking to Master Benn in the Masters' Retreat|<ref name="TOR" />}}
During the time of the Flesh Raider attacks on Tython, Matare feared for the safety of the Jedi Padawans in the Gnarls. He viewed all of Tython as dangerous, but viewed the region of the Gnarls as particularly so. While speaking with Master Benn on the subject, he agreed that the Padawans needed to be taught to identify darkness and dangerous situations, but he also believed that the Jedi Order could only deal with a certain amount of losses. Like all Jedi, Matare was sensitive to the Force. Matare had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and fair skin. He also had facial [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooes]] that were slightly darker in color than his skin on his forehead, cheeks, chin, and neck. During his time on the planet Tython, Matare wore brown and tan [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] with brown gloves and carried a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], the traditional weapon of the Jedi Order.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Matare first appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online roleplaying game|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]]. In the game, Matare appears as a character on the planet Tython in the Masters' Retreat, the starting area for players starting the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] or [[Jedi Consular]] classes. In the game, Matare has a conversation with Master Benn, which the player can observe and hear, but not be a part of. Although Matare wears the same type of Jedi robe and is the same level in the game as Master Benn, the game does not identify Matare as a Jedi Master. In the dialogue, Matare refers to Benn as "Master," but it is not specified whether or not Benn was Matare's Master. The game includes another Jedi named Matare on the planet Tython, a [[Matare (Human)|Human Padawan]] who is located near the ruins of the Temple of [[Kaleth]].<ref name="TOR" />
